components.name: Primary Utility Button
components.description: The near-black universal action that shifts toward Lens Violet on hover.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; background: #18181b; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(24,24,27,.18); font: 900 14px/1 'Archivo Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; transition: transform 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #7c3aed; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #ddd6fe; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.css: .ds-poster-card { display: block; width: 180px; color: #18181b; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-poster-art { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 3/4; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(145deg,#24133f,#7c3aed); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(24,24,27,.08); transition: transform 300ms ease, box-shadow 300ms ease; } .ds-poster-card:hover .ds-poster-art { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 18px 36px rgba(24,24,27,.16); } .ds-poster-badge { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 10px; background: rgba(24,24,27,.92); color: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; } .ds-poster-card strong { display: block; margin-top: 12px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-poster-card small { display: block; margin-top: 8px; color: #52525b; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-poster-card:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #ddd6fe; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 16px; }

narrative.overview:
ICC Lens treats a local file server like a compact editorial catalog: quiet zinc architecture frames poster-led content, while deep ink and a single violet action voice make the next consequence obvious. It feels deliberate and media-aware without pretending to be a commercial streaming service.

Density serves scanning. Headlines are compressed and confident, metadata stays compact, and the layout spends its largest areas on actual titles, posters, players, and episode rows. The approved Design A hierarchy is the authority; decoration never outranks the catalog or the path back to the original server.
keyCharacteristics: Poster-first catalog scanning on a cool neutral canvas.
One violet action voice paired with deep near-black utility controls.
Heavy, tightly tracked Archivo headlines and compact operational labels.
Clear differences between details, play, episode selection, and download.
Responsive stacking that keeps search and recovery actions available at narrow widths.

rules.name: The Violet Is a Verb Rule
rules.body: Violet marks an action, selection, focus, or product identity. Do not turn entire routine sections into violet decoration.

rules.name: The Contrast Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Metadata must use a neutral dark enough for AA contrast on both paper and white surfaces; subtlety never depends on washed-out gray.

rules.name: The Headline Earns the Width Rule
rules.body: Large type belongs to the current title or promise, never to generic section chrome.

rules.name: The Compact Does Not Mean Faint Rule
rules.body: Reduce metadata with size and space, not weak weight or insufficient contrast.

rules.name: The Content Owns the Viewport Rule
rules.body: Extra width goes to the feature, grid, or player—not to settings cards or decorative side rails.

rules.name: The Flat Until Useful Rule
rules.body: A shadow must explain interaction or layering. Routine white sections stay border-separated and flat.

rules.name: The Two-Radius Rule
rules.body: Default to 12px for controls and 16px for content surfaces; introduce a different radius only when size or circular geometry requires it.

dos: Do preserve the server-authored featured rail followed by the approved Design A poster grid.
Do keep search, Browse, and original-site recovery reachable at every supported width.
Do name whether an action opens details, plays media, selects an episode, or starts a download.
Do keep focus rings, AA contrast, reduced-motion behavior, and minimum touch targets intact.
Do let file, movie, and series details use visibly different primary surfaces.
donts: Don't autoplay the featured carousel, repeat it on category/search views, or let it dominate the first mobile viewport.
Don't scatter violet across routine containers or add a second accent color for normal actions.
Don't hide episode selection or download behind unlabeled icon-only controls.
Don't place every section in a floating card or give every neutral surface a shadow.
Don't remove the path back to the original server or visually disguise server-provided links.
